node.title: Why bounded awareness may prevent mission drift without exhaustive domain knowledge
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Place in the corpus: a missing causal and engineering bridge · 2. FH-C — causal priority of *unawareness of epistemic limits* · 3. FH-E — epistemic economy: less computation for the same mission-protection task.

relations: JUBAP’s perspective shift could motivate a test of whether recognizing a frame’s limits protects the mission more effectively than adding unrelated domain detail.
FH-C sigue siendo hipótesis de 2026; no fue una técnica formal aplicada en el caso de Nestlé de 2014.
The framework’s perspective shift may motivate a later test of epistemic-limit awareness, without making its historical cases evidence that FH-C is already proven.
Los casos anteriores, incluido 2014, no se describen como aplicaciones de FH-C de octubre de 2026.
A source-native factorial can make a bounded FH-C question more falsifiable without turning a synthetic mechanism into demonstrated real-world causal priority.
La nota FH-C permanece hipotética; el protocolo nuevo es Stage A en una rama abierta, no Stage B/C o validación de campo.
